summary: Meta's FAISS vector similarity search library released version 1.14.3 with new Metal GPU backend support, SIMD-based quantization and hardware-specific kernel optimizations, GPU pip wheel packaging, and various bug fixes and hardening changes.

practices.reason: The release adds concrete, reproducible quantization and SIMD kernel optimizations (TurboQuant, Sapphire Rapids VPOPCNTDQ kernels, HNSW search speedups) that a team running FAISS on its own stack could apply directly.
practices.quote: TurboQuant in ScalarQuantizer** — full Algorithm 2 (QJL stage) with SIMD and optimizations (#5170)

practices.reason: Enabling the Metal GPU backend by default on Apple Silicon and adding new GPU pip wheel packaging changes default behavior and installation surface that integrators should be aware of.
practices.quote: Metal now enabled by default on Apple Silicon machines (#5280)
